label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The colour swatch is a link with no name at all, so I could not tell which colour or option was selected; the gallery image links are also unnamed.

After pressing Add to bag nothing in the page told me the item was added: the button just became disabled and the cart drawer opened later, with the confirmation text only at the very end of the drawer.

My click on the Cart link was blocked by an open cart drawer whose close control was reported to me as a technical name (rebuy-cart-close) rather than Close Cart, and the page behind the drawer was still fully present in the tree, so it was unclear what was active.
The newsletter submit button in the footer is named just button, and several product colour links have a trailing comma with an empty colour name (for example Down Side Sleeper Pillow,).

The checkbox Email me with news and offers is ticked by default, so a customer must notice and untick it to decline promotions; the card fields are inside separate iframes, which makes the payment form harder to follow.
